subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs, with turnkey commercial hardware references omitted or routed to ClawHub/vendor docs?
rationale: The code/docs repair is straightforward, but the linked issue explicitly asks for hardware-docs placement policy and VISION.md routes ecosystem promotion outside core docs unless maintainers sponsor it.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Land the Jetson install guide once NVIDIA setup guidance and docs ordering are fixed, while keeping commercial turnkey hardware references out of the page.

options.title: Route Hardware Docs Out Of Core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask contributors to keep Jetson/appliance guidance in vendor docs or ClawHub if maintainers do not want first-party hardware install pages beyond existing precedent.

options.title: Sponsor A Broader Hardware Guide
options.body: Ask for a maintained hardware-install strategy that covers Jetson, Raspberry Pi, and mini PCs together before adding more first-party hardware pages.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Land the Jetson install guide once NVIDIA setup guidance and docs ordering are fixed, while keeping commercial turnkey hardware references out of the page.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product/docs scope, and steipete is the official maintainer tied to VISION and prior ClawHub/vendor-boundary history.
